name: Armenian Monastic Ensembles of Iran
description: In the mountains of north-west Iran, three Armenian Christian monastic complexes stand in the West and East Azerbaijan provinces: St Thaddeus, St Stepanos and the small Chapel of Dzordzor. The earliest, St Thaddeus, goes back to the 7th century, and the group spans roughly a thousand years of building. Still visited by pilgrims, they blend Armenian, Byzantine and Persian influences.
